title: Marketing, Launch & Growth
rules: Lead with the pain, not the feature; one sentence per audience segment.
Every claim needs a demo, a benchmark or a customer quote behind it.
Show HN post mortems: title must be the artifact, body must be honest about limits.
Reddit promotion requires karma and community-specific value; never cross-post spam.
Track CAC per channel and LTV per cohort before scaling spend.
Launch narrow: one ICP, one promise, one wedge feature.
Instrument activation before acquisition: a leaky funnel wastes every click.
checklist: Is there a one-line value proposition above the fold?
Does the landing page load in under 2s on 4G?
Is there a free, no-signup trial path to the wow moment?
Are OG meta tags and a share image present?
Is the launch channel list ranked by expected CAC?
Is there a feedback loop (email, analytics, changelog) after launch?

scoringRubric.1-3: Invisible: no positioning, no proof, no funnel instrumentation.
scoringRubric.4-6: Present but generic: unclear ICP, weak proof, leaky activation.
scoringRubric.7-8: Sharp: clear wedge, proof-backed claims, measured funnel, ranked channels.
scoringRubric.9-10: Compounding: referral loops, retained cohorts, channel-scaled CAC < LTV/3.
